datasets.name: grch38-chr22-gencode-v38
datasets.description: GRCh38 chr22 with the chr22 subset of GENCODE v38.  Produced in Brooks lab space by cafelton from public data, so it is re-derivable publicly.

datasets.name: lrgasp-grch38-sirvs-gencode-v38
datasets.description: The LRGASP reference bundle: GRCh38 plus the SIRV spike-ins, with GENCODE v38 plus the SIRV annotation.

datasets.name: grch38-gencode-v48
datasets.description: Whole genome GRCh38 primary assembly with GENCODE v48.  Both files are public; they are reached through Brooks lab space only because that is where the copies live.

datasets.name: a549-chr1-gencode-v48
datasets.description: A chr1 reference cut to the 300 kb window the A549 chr1 reads cover, paired with the whole genome GENCODE v48.  The annotation is not cut to the window; that is how the predecessor project ran it.

datasets.name: a549-chr5-gencode-v48
datasets.description: A chr5 reference cut to the 300 kb window the A549 chr5 reads cover, paired with the whole genome GENCODE v48, as for chr1.

datasets.name: saccer3-ares-v11
datasets.description: Yeast sacCer3 with the Ares v11 annotation, cleaned and with transcripts added.  Both are public; the yeast reads that go with them are not confirmed to be.

datasets.name: wtc11-chr22-pb
datasets.description: WTC11 PacBio cDNA from LRGASP, alignments subset to chr22.  The only sample with the BED12 form of its alignments, which the read recovery statistic needs.

datasets.name: wtc11-chr22-ont
datasets.description: WTC11 ONT cDNA from LRGASP, alignments subset to chr22.  The same reference as wtc11-chr22-pb, so the two differ only in platform.

datasets.name: wtc11-lrgasp-ont
datasets.description: Full size WTC11 ONT cDNA from LRGASP, three replicates, about 49 GB of reads.  Unaligned, so a run aligns them first.  The whole transcriptome case and the timing benchmark.

datasets.name: smarca4-b1a-kd-induced-rep1
datasets.description: SMARCA4 knockdown B1A, induced, replicate 1.  PacBio Kinnex Revio, Brooks lab, unpublished.  The misspelling SMARA4 is in the real file name.

datasets.name: smarca4-b1a-kd-induced-rep2
datasets.description: SMARCA4 knockdown B1A, induced, replicate 2.

datasets.name: smarca4-b1a-kd-unperturbed
datasets.description: SMARCA4 knockdown B1A, unperturbed control.

datasets.name: smarca4-b1b-kd-induced-rep1
datasets.description: SMARCA4 knockdown B1B, induced, replicate 1.

datasets.name: smarca4-b1b-kd-induced-rep2
datasets.description: SMARCA4 knockdown B1B, induced, replicate 2.

datasets.name: smarca4-b1b-kd-unperturbed
datasets.description: SMARCA4 knockdown B1B, unperturbed control.

datasets.name: smarca4-scrambled-induced-nonspecific
datasets.description: SMARCA4 scrambled guide, induced, non-specific control.

datasets.name: smarca4-scrambled-unperturbed
datasets.description: SMARCA4 scrambled guide, unperturbed control.

datasets.name: a549-chr1-pb
datasets.description: A549 long reads from a 300 kb window on chr1, unaligned FASTA.  Brooks lab.

datasets.name: a549-chr5-pb
datasets.description: A549 long reads from a 300 kb window on chr5, unaligned FASTA.  Brooks lab.

datasets.name: a549-drna
datasets.description: A549 ONT direct RNA, aligned to hg38.  The only direct RNA sample, so the only one exercising the non-cDNA code paths.  Brooks lab.

datasets.name: yeast-ont
datasets.description: One thousand yeast ONT reads.  Small and fast, the smoke test on a compact genome.  Restricted because nothing records where the read file came from; confirm that before calling it public.

datasets.name: wtc11-chr22-junctions
datasets.description: WTC11 short read junctions from STAR.  Whole genome, not cut to chr22, unlike everything else used with the chr22 reference.

datasets.name: wtc11-lrgasp-junctions
datasets.description: WTC11 short read junctions from STAR, on the LRGASP reference.  Believed to be the same file as wtc11-chr22-junctions; confirm when the data symlinks are made and merge the two if so.

datasets.name: yeast-junctions
datasets.description: Yeast short read junctions.  Provenance not recorded, so restricted until it is.

datasets.name: a549-cage
datasets.description: A549 CAGE peaks, TSS evidence.  The file the predecessor project named no longer exists; the replacement has not been chosen.

datasets.name: wtc11-polya
datasets.description: WTC11 poly(A) peaks, TES evidence.  The predecessor project used these with A549 direct RNA, which looks like a mistake in the original rather than a choice; they are kept here as a separate entry so that using them is a visible decision.
